text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush into the waiting room to congratulate T.M. Opera O on her victory.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The masses applaud and rejoice. I am strong, yet elegant—unobscured brilliance incarnate.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am the high, the mighty, T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Now sing your praises of my triumphant victory!
choice_data_list: This victory is just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… I graciously accept your kindness. Let me gift you a few of my own…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Words of prophecy! After the next race, your praises shall ring once again!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How do I know? Because both you and the natural world…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O is already confident she'll win the next race!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! Trainer, you are absolutely correct.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just as my beauty persists endlessly into the future, this forward march will not come to a halt.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Not until I, the Centurial Overlord, bring my light of good fortune unto the entire world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As such, it is only natural that you, my trainer, should comprehend the philosophy of it.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thus, I make this inquiry. What is it we should do next?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent! Let us begin at once, so that I may claim a brilliance unparalleled—and illuminate the heavens themselves!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, in pursuit of our next victory, we train rigorously under the shining sun!
